sloka: सर्वासु विद्यासु तपोविधाने प्रस्पर्धते ऽयो हि गुरुं सुराणाम् ।सो ऽयं नवव्याकरणार्थवेत्ता ब्रह्मा भविष्यत्यपि ते प्रसादात् ।। ७.३६.४८ ॥
transliteration: sarvāsu vidyāsu tapovidhāne praspardhate 'yo hi guruṁ surāṇām ।so 'yaṁ navavyākaraṇārthavettā brahmā bhaviṣyatyapi te prasādāt ।। 7.36.48 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, he rivals the preceptor of the gods (Brihaspati) in all branches of knowledge and in the practice of austerities, and this knower of the nine grammars and their meanings will even become Brahma by your grace.
